title: 第5章 娶妻缘由血食第6章 入阶
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 中午吃饭，又遇到了想拜干爹走捷径的。
沈云严词拒绝。
他上午对沈启强的态度，让府内不少仆人动了心思。
面对沈云都多了三分热情，一些年轻的护院见他，脸上也有三分讨好。
午睡一会儿，下午和对面管事房的风老头下起了棋。
风老头是风家旁系，负责府上采买事宜，算不得仆人也算不得主子。
觅仙城内风府的主人，只有家主风治嫡系这一脉。
城外风家堡，还生活着大量风家旁支族人。
沈云执棋抬手，镇压风老头。
“我没看见。”
风老头狠狠地拍了下大腿，就要悔棋，“不能算，让我一步！”
“你这厮忒不爽利，输了就输了，总喜欢悔棋。”
沈云寸步不让，两个须发皆白的老头争执起来。
“我只被吃一子而已！到你嘴里就输了？”
风老头被沈云气的面色红润有光泽，两人越下越年轻。
“还不是老沈头你故意遮挡，尽使些盘外招，纵使被吃一子，老头子我还占优......”
半个时辰后，还没有增加福报点，沈云懒得和风老头下棋，转身回了管事房。
连输三局，身心愉悦不起来。
作为两世臭棋篓子，真想效仿大汉棋圣。
回到房间，沈云沉吟着从风老头那打听的消息。
风老头是风府采购，儿子还是城卫队的成员，消息灵通。
这几日，潜龙山脉深处发生地动，有不少荒兽向外逃窜，每日都有采药人发现奇珍异植。
都在传将有千年份的神药或至宝出世。
“我现在有了呼吸法，无需异植，想来血元丹便能助我入阶！”
沈云彻底息了去城外潜龙山脉的心思。
那里已经成了是非之地，今日府内还有几个少爷小姐去寻宝。
“砰砰~”
临近下值，敲门声传来。
沈云以为是那几个殷勤的学徒，头也没抬，喊道：“进来。”
“沈伯，您老新婚才几天，还在忙着查账呢！”
清脆的女声响起，一袭绿衣，略显俏皮的女子推门而入。
沈云这才抬头一看，诧异道：“小绿萝。”手一翻，将账本合上。
“来找老头子是大夫人有什么吩咐吗？”
绿萝和沈云妻子婉儿，都是风家主母罗映红的亲信丫鬟。
这几年，两人最得罗映红器重。
她们出现往往意味着主母有令。
“夫人让我给你送点东西过来。”
绿萝从怀里掏出一个锦盒，一封手书。
沈云瞥了一眼，取出盒子后，小绿萝本就不富裕的身材更加平坦。
这和婉儿完全是两个极端。
content_en:
At lunch, I met someone who wanted to take a shortcut to become a godfather.
Shen Yun sternly refused.
His attitude towards Shen Qiqiang this morning made many servants in the house think.
Facing Shen Yun, everyone became more enthusiastic, and some of the young nursing staff looked at him with flattering expressions on their faces.
After taking a nap, I played chess with Old Man Feng in the steward's room across from me in the afternoon.
Old Man Feng is a branch of the Feng family and is responsible for purchasing matters in the house. He is neither a servant nor a master.
The only owner of Feng Mansion in Xixian City is the direct descendant of the head of the family, Feng Zhi.
Outside the city, there are still a large number of people from the Fengjia branch living in Fengjiabao.
"Eat..."
Chen Yun held the chess piece and raised his hand to suppress Old Man Feng.
"I didn't see it."
Old Man Feng slapped his thigh hard and was about to regret his move, "I can't count, let me make a move!"
"You're such a bad guy. If you lose, you lose. You always like to regret your moves."
Shen Yun refused to give in, and the two old men with white hair and beards started to argue.
"I only got eaten once! Will I lose when it comes to your mouth?"
Old man Feng's face was rosy and shiny due to Shen Yunqi, and the two of them were getting younger and younger.
"It's not like Old Shen, you deliberately blocked your way and used some off-beat moves. Even if you get beaten, I still have the advantage, old man..."
Half an hour later, with no luck points added, Shen Yun was too lazy to play chess with Old Man Feng and turned back to the steward's room.
After losing three games in a row, I couldn’t feel happy physically or mentally.
As a bad chess player for two generations, I really want to imitate the Han chess master.
Back in the room, Chen Yun pondered over the news he had learned from Old Man Feng.
Old man Feng is a purchaser for Feng Mansion, and his son is also a member of the city guard, so he is well-informed.
In the past few days, an earthquake has occurred deep in the Qianlong Mountains. Many wild beasts have fled outwards. Every day, medicinal collectors discover rare and exotic plants.
It is said that a thousand-year-old miracle medicine or treasure will be released.
"Now that I have the breathing method, I don't need a foreign transplant. I think the Blood Essence Pill can help me advance to the next level!"
Chen Yun completely stopped thinking about going to the Qianlong Mountains outside the city.
That place has become a place of right and wrong, and today there are still several young masters and ladies in the house going treasure hunting.
"Bang bang~"
Near the end of the day, there was a knock on the door.
Shen Yun thought it was those diligent apprentices, and without raising his head, he shouted: "Come in."
"Uncle Shen, you have only been married for a few days, and you are still busy checking the accounts!"
A crisp female voice sounded, and a slightly naughty woman in green clothes pushed open the door and entered.
Only then did Chen Yun look up and said in surprise: "Little green dill." He flipped his hand and closed the ledger.
"Do you have any orders from the madam who came to see the old man?"
Luluo and Shen Yun's wife Wan'er are both trusted maids of Luo Yinghong, the mistress of the Feng family.
In recent years, the two of them have gained the most respect from Luo Yinghong.
Their appearance often means that the mistress has an order.
"Madam asked me to bring you something."
Luluo took out a brocade box and a handwritten letter from her arms.
Shen Yun glanced at it. After taking out the box, the little green dill's figure, which was already not rich, became even flatter.
This is completely the opposite extreme from Wan'er.
